summary: Build practical tourism sustainability skills with GSTC-aligned tools, reporting templates, and action plans. Enrol today.
lede: Responsible tourism management focuses on assessing tourism impacts and balancing visitor activity with environmental and community needs. The course is designed for professionals across destinations, properties, and travel services who need to monitor impacts and coordinate improvements alongside ongoing operations. Learners practice building impact baselines and KPI reports, planning visitor management, and screening suppliers.
audienceIntro: This advanced sustainable and responsible tourism training is for professionals who need to manage tourism impacts, coordinate stakeholders, and report measurable sustainability progress across destinations, properties, or travel services.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Participants should have working knowledge of tourism operations, destination management, hospitality, or travel services. Prior exposure to ESG reporting, environmental management, or quality improvement is helpful but not mandatory. No coding is required, although the course uses digital templates, KPI dashboards, and spreadsheet-based analysis. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, with strategy and certification pathways covered at a practical overview level.
